analysis:
This batch contains only test files, and none of them change production code. StatusResidencyTests.swift (head 118-176) adds CLI status tests. They cover selected_model_recovery, enabled_models_at_start and enabled_models_at_last_switch rendering, plus a restart-needed notice. AutopilotPlacementFixture.swift (head 120-127) adds test-only setters for autopilotResidentSince and autopilotLeaseUntil. SelectedModelPlacementPolicyTests.swift, SelectedModelRecoveryFixture.swift and SelectedModelRecoveryPolicyTests.swift are new.

The new tests describe a new production feature, SelectedModelRecovery, whose implementation is not in this batch. Behaviour the tests expect:
- Retries back off from 30s up to 600s.
- An expired Autopilot adoption (hold, minimum dwell and lease all over) is released and evicted after its in-flight requests drain.
- Holds are always honoured.
- Models in the running selection are never evicted.
- Checks pause while a drain, Autopilot operation, switch, preload or live Autopilot lease owns residency.
- A recovery attempt reports busy as .preload.
- Load failures other than memory refusals end the recovery.

Security relevance is mainly availability and residency (TB-007; T-029, T-010-like drain semantics). Autopilot is a coordinator-commanded residency control. The tests indicate that recovery defers to a live lease and is mutually exclusive with other residency owners, which limits races with coordinator commands.

The daemon state now exposes blocker strings in the local state file and CLI. These carry model IDs, memory figures and request-in-flight counts, but no prompt data (A-001).

No regression is identified from the test code itself. For the next pass, check the production sources: ProviderLoop selected-model recovery, eviction and unadvertise logic, and the busy-flag mutual exclusion.
- Release must stop new routing before eviction, and in-flight requests must finish rather than be cut off, so plaintext responses (T-008) are not lost or mis-routed.
- A recovery load must not bypass weight-hash or advertised-model checks (T-012, T-027).
- The daemon-state file permissions must stay unchanged.
